title: 1955 AHSME Problem 11
statement: The negation of the statement “No slow learners attend this school,” is:

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: All slow learners attend this school.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: All slow learners do not attend this school.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: Some slow learners attend this school.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: Some slow learners do not attend this school.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: No slow learners do not attend this school.

solutions.text:
The original statement says that every slow learner is absent from the school. Its negation is that at least one slow learner attends the school.

Thus, “Some slow learners attend this school” is correct, so the answer is C.
hints: “No” means that there does not exist even one example
Negating a universal exclusion asserts the existence of a counterexample
